## Why This Is Asked
Tests multi-sensor fusion, temporal consistency, and edge constraints not covered by prior questions. Probes architecture choices for on-device latency, 5-shot adaptation, and robust pose estimation in cluttered environments.

## Key Concepts
- Edge inference and embedded GPU budgets
- IMU/ego-motion fusion for depth disambiguation
- Few-shot on-device adaptation with adapters and meta-learning
- 6-DoF pose plus segmentation in a dynamic, cluttered scene

## Code Example
```python
def ekf_update(state, measurement, F, H, Q, R):
    # simple EKF update skeleton for pose state
    pred = F @ state
    S = H @ pred + R
    K = pred @ np.linalg.inv(S)
    y = measurement - H @ pred
    return pred + K @ y
```

- What failure modes are most likely and how would you mitigate them?

## Why This Is Asked
This question probes practical monocular 3D pose estimation in a human-robot collaboration setting with occlusions and quick adaptation to new PPE and tools, reflecting real-world constraints on edge devices.

- Monocular 3D pose for multiple agents
- Interaction-aware reasoning and contact constraints
- Temporal tracking with short windows
- On-device adaptation via adapters or meta-learning
- Synthetic+real data fusion and occlusion handling

## Code Example

```javascript
function poseLoss(pred, gt){
  // 3D keypoint L2 loss with visibility masking
  const diff = pred.keypoints.filter(v => v.visible).map((p,i)=>p - gt.keypoints[i]);
  return diff.reduce((a,b)=>a+b*b, 0);
}
```
